tools.name: batch_search
tools.description:
Run many person/location lookups in one call (row-in / row-out).

    Each row goes through the SAME engine as search_offenders, so a row's records
    are identical to what a single search would return. A row that fails is
    reported with status='error' in place and never aborts the batch. Max 10

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_registry_coverage · Private data: search_offenders, batch_search, get_registry_coverage, search_criminal, get_criminal_coverage · Public sink: get_criminal_coverage · Destructive: batch_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_registry_coverage · Private data: search_offenders, batch_search, get_registry_coverage, search_criminal, get_criminal_coverage · Public sink: get_criminal_coverage · Destructive: batch_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
